# Game functions that run most (USA addresses, hottest first): the recompiler (recomp/compile.cpp) puts
# them together into modules of their own, loaded first: the code that runs every frame then sits in a
# few MiB instead of spread over ~40 MiB (instruction cache and TLB misses at function entries were ~9%
# of the game thread on a Helio G85), and small hot callees can be inlined into their hot callers.
# From simpleperf profiles of all game threads (Helio G85, Outset). Changing it recompiles those modules.
